data.logical:
SELECT
  customer.id AS customer_id,
  customer.first_name,
  customer.last_name,
  customer.email,
  SUM(payment.amount) AS total_spent

GROUP BY customer.id, customer.first_name, customer.last_name, customer.email
ORDER BY total_spent DESC
LIMIT 10
